newsitem.title: GERMANY: HOCKEY-U.S. BEAT KOREANS, OLYMPIC CHAMPIONS HELD.
newsitem.headline: HOCKEY-U.S. BEAT KOREANS, OLYMPIC CHAMPIONS HELD.

text.p: A second half goal by substitute Carla Tagiente carried the United States to a 1-0 victory over Olympic silver medallists South Korea in the opening match of the women's Champions' Trophy hockey tournament on Sunday.
Just as they did at the Atlanta Olympics last year when they won 3-2, the Americans upstaged their more fancied rivals thanks to Tagiente's goal four minutes into the second half.
Kelly James fed a free-hit to Tara Maguire who pulled the ball back for Tagiente to score.
A few minutes later Korea's Eun-yopung Lee was carried off and taken to hospital after the ball hit her in the neck.
The United States defended superbly, holding out the Koreans who had seven clear chances from corners.
Britta Becker's penalty conversion five minutes from time earned Germany a 1-1 draw with Olympic champions Australia.
The Australians had taken the lead in the 29th minute when Alyson Annan, top scorer at the Atlanta Games, scored with a corner shot.
